authority_text: stochastic label instability is at most 0.10 per family/candidate
denominator: stochastic_aggregate_totals[(family, candidate)] -- the count of candidate aggregates with len(replicas) > 1
escape_clause_comparison: gate 3 alone carries 'or a scientific-scope review explicitly justifies failure'; gate 7 does not
failure_consequence: A failed gate blocks training; it does not authorize geometry, target or threshold tuning against model results.

implementation_artifacts.role: computes replica_instability and stochastic_aggregate_totals per (family, candidate)

intended_scientific_rationale: the frozen counterfactual rollout protocol anticipates mixed replica outcomes and flags them (docs/RVT_COUNTERFACTUAL_ROLLOUT_PROTOCOL.md: 'Mixed outcomes set the instability flag'). Gate 7 is therefore a dataset-quality budget bounding how often that anticipated flag may fire, not a validity condition on individual labels.
name: GATE7_AUTHORITY_REGISTRY_V1
scope: per (family, candidate_topology) cell; only F8 and F9 carry three replicas, so only those four cells per split are constrained
unit: one candidate aggregate that carries more than one replica
